what.text: This page follows refugees from Russia living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 18198 Russian refugees in Germany, 18.3% of all refugees from Russia.
France hosts the most Russian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Chechnya territory in Russia from 1999 to 2007, at war level in some years, and over Caucasus Emirate territory from 2007 to 2015.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002, and the figure was at its highest, 45568, at the end of 2003.
It fell to a low in 2013 and then rose again; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
